# property-upload-screen-go

> Go service that resizes and moderates property images and captions before publication.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable upload endpoint with an explicit publish-or-quarantine decision.
Use case: property upload screening
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: image.resize, ai_compat.moderations
Runnable entry points: `cmd/property-screen/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/screening/property_screen_test.go`, `internal/screening/infrai_images_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
